title: Isomorphism pullback gives a coherent t-exact rational coefficient family
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $g:X\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$ be an isomorphism of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; noetherian and finite-dimensional mean a finite affine noetherian cover and a bound on chains of irreducible closed subsets. For every finite subextension $E\subset\Omega$ choose its valuation ring $A_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the completed coefficient sheaves $R_{E,W}=\varprojlim_n(A_E/\varpi_E^n)_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the integral categories $\mathcal C_{E,W}=D^b_c(W,A_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and their raw rationalizations $\mathcal D_{E,W}=\mathcal C_{E,W}[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Equip the integral categories with their bounded standard t-structures [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure] and the rational ones with the t-structures whose halves are the isomorphism closures of the integral halves [prop-weil-localized-tstructure].

The actual completed integral pullback $F_E^{\mathrm{int}}=Lg_E^*$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] maps $\mathcal C_{E,Y}$ into $\mathcal C_{E,X}$ and is $A_E$-linear, exact and t-exact. Its exact shift structure is the transport of the termwise inverse-image shift structure through the canonical derived isomorphism $Lg_E^*K\cong g^{-1}K$, with coefficient action transported along $g^{-1}R_{E,Y}\cong R_{E,X}$. Its rationalization is the actual prescribed $F_E=Lg_E^*:\mathcal D_{E,Y}\to\mathcal D_{E,X}$, and is exact and t-exact.

For $E\subset L$ write $T^W_{L/E}$ for the completed integral scalar-extension functor [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] or its rationalization, as appropriate. The integral pullback scalar-extension comparison $\alpha_{L/E,K}:(Lg_E^*K)\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg_L^*(K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L)$ of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension], which is the comparison $\theta^{g^*}$ used for pullback in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], extends to an exact natural isomorphism
$$\beta_{L/E}:T^X_{L/E}F_E\xrightarrow{\sim}F_LT^Y_{L/E}.$$
On integral arrows it is the image of $\alpha_{L/E}$; it is obtained by semilinear scalar localization for $A_E\to A_L$, sending a fraction $u/\varpi_E^n$ to the image of $u$ multiplied by $\varpi_E^{-n}$ in $L$. These are comparisons of the actual functors on all rational morphisms. They preserve shift comparisons, are identities for $L=E$, and satisfy the tower equation with the canonical scalar associators of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension].

Assemble the specified integral scalar comparison into a natural isomorphism using the naturality clause of specifiedPullbackComparisonAlpha. Apply the scalar-shift lemma to the same chosen stage shifts and normalized inverse-image comparisons. The rational comparison normalization is the existing prescribed component theorem.

Apply the unit and tower lemmas to the integral natural-isomorphism family (B E L h).integral, with its component normalization fields. Their integral equations now refer directly to that same family, so no separate transport of a large component equality is needed. Their rational equations use the existing prescribed rational comparisons and the canonical rational unitor and associator. The shared field-structured inclusion presentation is used consistently.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismPullback_tExact_coefficients
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (_hDimX : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)
    (_hDimY : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ n)
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    (fun [_iX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
      [_iY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] ↦
        ∃ S : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
            IsomorphismPullbackCoefficientStage l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g hX hY,
          ∃ B : ∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L),
            IsomorphismPullbackScalarComparison l Ω g hX hY S E L h,
            IsomorphismPullbackCoefficientCoherence l Ω g hX hY S B)
      (_iX := isomorphismPullbackResidueUnits l X hX)
      (_iY := isomorphismPullbackResidueUnits l Y hY)
